summary: Working lab sheet for targeted renewal interventions. Rows are prioritized by probability x ARR exposure. Use this as the operational source for the CS team to assign actions, track legal/commercial blockers, and estimate recovered ARR per cycle.
notes: How to read: Probability is CS-assessed likelihood to renew at list/near-list terms. Stage is shorthand (exec-review, legal-review, negotiation, technical-trial, at-risk, churn-risk). Next Step is the immediate action owner should take and an expected SLA. Color buckets (manual): red <40%, amber 40-70%, green >70%. Escalation rules: any account >$250k with probability <60% => escalate to AM + Solutions Eng lead. Links: reference playbook snippets below and attach QBR slide export when available.
playbook_steps: Tiering: Bucket accounts by ARR * (1 - probability) to get $ at risk
Immediate outreach: owner to send tailored value recap + 1 concrete ask (meeting, PO, legal signoff)
Escalation: For large at-risk accounts, schedule sponsor-level call within 7 business days
Technical unblock: open a SE ticket and offer time-boxed performance/Demo window
Commercial options: suggest staged renewal, pilot-to-enterprise path, or short-term bridge pricing
kpi_estimates: ARR at risk (sum of ARR * (1 - probability)): $1,126,200
